exercises.title: Part 1 · 1
exercises.prompt: Music What types of music do you like to listen to? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 2
exercises.prompt: Music At what times of day do you like to listen to music? [Why?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 3
exercises.prompt: Music Did you learn to play a musical instrument when you were a child? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 1 · 4
exercises.prompt: Music Do you think all children should learn to play a musical instrument? [Why/Why not?]

exercises.title: Part 2 · 1
exercises.prompt: Describe a shop near where you live that you sometimes use. You should say: what sorts of product or service it sells what the shop looks like where it is located and explain why you use this shop.

exercises.title: Part 3 · 1
exercises.prompt: Local business What types of local business are there in your neighbourhood? Are there any restaurants, shops or dentists for example?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 2
exercises.prompt: Local business Do you think local businesses are important for a neighbourhood? In what way?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 3
exercises.prompt: Local business How do large shopping malls and commercial centres affect small local businesses? Why do you think that is?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 4
exercises.prompt: People and business Why do some people want to start their own business?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 5
exercises.prompt: People and business Are there any disadvantages to running a business? Which is the most serious?

exercises.title: Part 3 · 6
exercises.prompt: People and business What are the most important qualities that a good business person needs? Why is that?
